name: Wit of the Black Moon
body:
School evocation [negative energy]; Level: jester 3

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Touch
Target: Creature touched
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Reflex special (see text); Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target suffers 1d8 points of negative energy damage, plus an additional point for each caster level. With a failed save, the target is also blinded.

For the duration of the encounter, you benefit from ‘concealment’ against the target, even if they succeed their save.
